mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer confidence, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained RSAFS declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 1.5% signals accelerating supply activity, which boosts corporate earnings and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of INDPRO > 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals robust labor market growth, which boosts corporate earnings and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of PAYEMS > 200,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 2% signals easing inflationary pressures, which reduces the likelihood of aggressive Fed rate hikes and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of CPIAUCSL < 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below 1,000,000 units signals weakening residential construction activity, which reduces demand for building materials and related equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of HOUST < 1,000,000 (t-test p > 0.05).
